messages.content:
Elian, I’m new, and just started! How many runes do we need? 

- 6 runes, the exact same rune page opens at level 140, so remember to keep some spare runes!

Hey Elian, I’m *LVL 152* NOW!! 

I can enhance runes now.. what do I do? 

What if I don’t have S runes? 

What if I only have C, B runes? 

Fret not. All enhanced runes can be dismantled, or reforged their skills in, they will return all the materials used for enhancements!

Go ahead and enhance them to boost BP and rating!

Personally think the following is too minute to make a difference
- Movement Speed
- + Ranks to Skill
- Experienced : Experienced Hunting/Insight/Acquity
- Mini clan 

What skills to keep? 
- Orange, yellow ones
- cool-down runes 
- giant blessings 
- braver with more battle

Abyss rewards for HELL
Rating requirement 550k

- 25 runs - 500 abyss ticket 
- 50 runs - 1500 rune enhancement potions 
- 80 runs - 800 abyss tickets 
- 120 runs - 2000 rune enhancement potions 
- 160 runs - 5 abyss crystals

Abyss rewards for SHURA 
Rating requirement 1140k

- 30 runs - 800 abyss ticket 
- 60 runs - 2500 rune enhancement potions 
- 90 runs - 800 abyss tickets 
- 120 runs - 3000 rune enhancement potions 
- 150 runs - 1000 abyss tickets 
- 180 runs - 5 abyss crystals

I have 10k abyss energy! I wanna risk it to buy the 10k 5 star runes!!!! 

Let me stop you.

Do you know? That you need 4820 per rune to hit lvl 12 enhancement? 

If you use 10k abyss energy to buy a red runes that probably gives you 30k extra rating, you’re losing out on 19800 solvents! 

That is the cost of 4 level 12 runes that could potentially bring your rating to way way way higher than you thought.

And if during the journey of hunting for 5 star runes and you luckily managed to get 1, what can you do? 
- Fret not, you can dismantle them! You’ll get back the exact amount of solvents that you used to enhance! 
- But you won’t get back any solvents used for recasting!

Oh what if I have good skills in them?
- same, you still get back the solvents after reforging the skills in!

I want to balance them out! What should I do? 
- you can alternatively balance out 5 of them to lvl 9 instead of making 3 of them to level 12.
- it’s to gain more rating per level, and also to ensure you hit more attributes too

*I WANT TO APPRAISE!!!*
- don’t. We are not yet at the stage that we are ready to appraise yet. 
- we do not have S runes with 3 skill lines, your recast master isn’t ready yet.
2 cursed toxin runes, 1 at 4s the other at 3s

Seems like abyss mode chaos required rune rating at lvl 161 is 

1.32m or 1320k

***LUCKY RECAST***

After recasting your runes sufficient time, you will trigger a lucky recast.

Lucky Recast allows you to swap one of your existing Bonus Attributes with one of the 4 Random Attribute, where 1 of the Random Attributes is guaranteed to be S rank. 

Regardless of whether you choose to swap your selected attribute with one of the random attributes, the Lucky Cast will reset afterwards, and will require another 375 Recasts to be triggered again.

Abyss Requirement
HELL : 550k Rune Rating
SHURA : 1.14m Rune Rating
CHAOS : 1.32m Rune Rating
DESPAIR : 1.45m Rune Rating
HAVOC : 1.53m Rune Rating
EPIC : 1.68m Rune Rating
